description: Commit all structural changes made in FEAT-001 through FEAT-003 to the current branch. Create a single descriptive commit covering all file moves, namespace updates, and project-file exclusions. Do not push. This feature is independent of FEAT-001/002/003 ordering concerns — it runs after all three are complete and verified.
steps: Confirm FEAT-001, FEAT-002, and FEAT-003 are all complete and dotnet build passes with 0 errors.
From c:\Users\User\OneDrive\Desktop\SchoolManagementSystem\backend, run: git status to review all changed and new files.

Stage all changes in the four project directories: git add SchoolManagementSystem.Domain SchoolManagementSystem.Infrastructure SchoolManagementSystem.WebApi. Do NOT stage .agents/ or .kiro/ directories.

Verify staged files with git diff --cached --stat and confirm no Migrations files, no AppDbContext.cs, no Program.cs (logic change), no DependencyInjection.cs (logic change) appear as content-changed — only using/namespace changes in those files are expected.

Create a commit: git commit -m 'refactor: feature-based folder restructure (Domain/Infra/WebApi)

Move Domain entities, enums, and exceptions into Features/<Feature>/ subfolders.
Move Infrastructure auth/email/notifications/storage/configurations/repositories/seeder into Features/<Feature>/ subfolders.
Move WebApi controllers, authorization, and models into Features/<Feature>/ subfolders.
Update all namespace declarations and using directives across all projects.
Application files were already correctly structured — no Application changes.
Old flat-folder files excluded via <Compile Remove> in .csproj files; not deleted (awaiting user approval per restructuring-plan.md Phase 4).'
acceptance_criteria: A git commit exists on branch refactor/backend-structure containing all file changes from FEAT-001/002/003
The commit message clearly identifies this as a structural-only refactor
No push to remote has been made
dotnet build still passes with 0 errors after the commit
verification: Confirm output shows 'Build succeeded' and '0 Error(s)'
git log --oneline -1 to confirm commit exists
